subject: English
question_text: Write a paragraph on "Your Favorite pastime" in about
stimulus: 250 words answering the questions below. 10 (a) What is pastime? (b) What is your favourite pastime? (c) Why is it your favourite pastime? (d) When and how do you make time to spend for your favourite pastime? (e) What benefits do you get from it? Why is pastime significant for everyone?
